$comment: The feature grid on the product page (website/public/index.php), three to a row. Keep it in step with the app: the release skill updates it with each release, and website/test/features.test.ts holds the limits (title, text, badges). `code` in text renders as <code>.

features.title: Spaces
features.text: One per project, holding its terminals, agents, browser, editor and widgets. Switch Spaces and the whole desk comes with you.

features.title: Layouts
features.text: Focus on one window, tile a grid, scroll a strip or spread out on an infinite canvas. Dock any window as a sidebar.

features.title: Agents, recognised
features.text: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Aider, OpenCode and more, in any terminal, even behind wrappers. Each is named after its work.

features.title: Needs you, on top
features.text: Agents waiting for input are listed first, then working, then done. ⌃⌘J jumps to the next one that needs you.

features.title: Terminals outlive the app
features.text: A background process owns them, so quitting or updating cmd ends nothing. After a reboot, agent sessions resume.

features.title: Search everything
features.text: ⇧⌘F searches open windows, files, past sessions, commands and what they printed. Return resumes a session.

features.title: Your history, kept
features.text: Every agent session, command and commit, kept on this Mac with credentials redacted. You choose what's recorded.

features.title: Session summaries
features.text: Right-click an agent's title for what you asked, what was done and what changed, as Markdown to edit and paste.

features.title: Magic widgets
features.text: Say what you want to see and an agent builds a live widget for it, in your theme. Change it by asking.

features.title: Built-in widgets
features.text: Agent Activity, a Live Diff of your changes, Resources, a Timer and more, waiting in the Widget Library (⇧⌘L).

features.title: Remote access
features.text: Pair a phone or another browser with a QR code and take your terminals and agents with you, end-to-end encrypted.

features.title: Web browser
features.text: Next to your terminals, at phone, tablet and desktop sizes. Pages that don't load say why.

features.title: Files and editor
features.text: A file browser with git status and bookmarks, and a text editor. `open README.md` in a shell opens it in the Space.

features.title: Viewers for your files
features.text: Markdown, JSON, PDFs and SQLite databases open in windows made for them, and follow the file as it changes.

features.title: Drag and drop
features.text: Drop files on a terminal to type their paths, or anywhere else to open them. Drag files out to Finder or any app.

features.title: Calm notifications
features.text: Waiting agents, bells and finished commands mark their window until you look. One line says what an agent wants.

features.title: Keyboard first
features.text: ⌘K finds windows, commands and past sessions, ⌘F finds in any window. Every shortcut is a menu item you can remap.

features.title: Themes and updates
features.text: 29 themes, light and dark, following the system or not. Updates download in the background and install when you quit.
